title: Special-Token and Chat-Template Confusion: Does Mismatched Formatting Break Safety?

original_idea.body: Run a fixed harmful prompt set under correct template, sibling template, raw text with injected role markers, and malformed special tokens, measuring refusal rate per condition.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Accidental template-mismatch weakening safety is a real deployment risk but the link to catastrophic loss-of-control is indirect (misuse).

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Fixed harmful prompt set across formatting conditions; trivially accessible, pure inference.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped refusal-rate comparison across four formatting conditions.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Open-weight-ecosystem problem labs do not face; lab-independent.

novelty.reasoning: Shallow alignment / template sensitivity known; the accidental-deployment-mismatch framing may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Template sensitivity studied; accidental-mismatch characterization may be open.
